Heatmor

Fire

Unova · Generation 5

Heatmor is a Fire-type Anteater Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1.4 m tall and weighs 58 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (105), with a base stat total of 484.
